theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.IsTransport.comp_perm {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] {ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A} {κ c : ℂ} (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {γ γ' : ℝ → Fin n → ℂ} {U : ℝ → A} (hU : IsTransport (kzForm ρ κ c) γ γ' U) :
IsTransport (kzForm ρ κ c) (fun (t : ℝ) => γ t ∘ ⇑π) (fun (t : ℝ) => γ' t ∘ ⇑π) fun (t : ℝ) => ρ π⁻¹ * U t * ρ π

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm_comp_perm {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (z u : Fin n → ℂ) :
(kzForm ρ κ c (z ∘ ⇑π)) (u ∘ ⇑π) = ρ π⁻¹ * (kzForm ρ κ c z) u * ρ π

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm_equivariant {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (z u : Fin n → ℂ) :
ρ π * (kzForm ρ κ c (z ∘ ⇑π)) (u ∘ ⇑π) = (kzForm ρ κ c z) u * ρ π

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzOp_equivariant {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (c : ℂ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (z u : Fin n → ℂ) :
ρ π * kzOp ρ c (z ∘ ⇑π) (u ∘ ⇑π) = kzOp ρ c z u * ρ π

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm_zero {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (c : ℂ) (z u : Fin n → ℂ) :
(kzForm ρ 0 c z) u = 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm_isFlatOn {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) :
IsFlatOn (kzForm ρ κ c) (kzForm' ρ κ c) (confSet n)

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.continuousOn_kzTerm {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (a b : Fin n) :
ContinuousOn (fun (z : Fin n → ℂ) => (kzCoeff' κ z a b • pairDiff a b).smulRight (kzL ρ c a b)) (confSet n)

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.smulRight_smul_eq {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (w : ℂ) (P : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ) (L : (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] A) :
(w • P).smulRight L = w.re • P.smulRight L + w.im • (Complex.I • P).smulRight L

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.hasFDerivAt_kzTerm {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) {y : Fin n → ℂ} (a b : Fin n) (hab : a ≠ b → y a ≠ y b) :
HasFDerivAt (fun (z : Fin n → ℂ) => (κ * (z a - z b)⁻¹) • kzL ρ c a b) ((kzCoeff' κ y a b • pairDiff a b).smulRight (kzL ρ c a b)) y

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm'_symm {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (z δ u : Fin n → ℂ) :
((kzForm' ρ κ c z) δ) u = ((kzForm' ρ κ c z) u) δ

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm'_apply {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (z δ u : Fin n → ℂ) :
((kzForm' ρ κ c z) δ) u = ∑ a : Fin n, ∑ b : Fin n, (kzCoeff' κ z a b * (δ a - δ b) * (u a - u b)) • resid ρ c a b

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm_apply {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (z u : Fin n → ℂ) :
(kzForm ρ κ c z) u = κ • kzOp ρ c z u

(Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] A

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzCoeff' {n : ℕ} (κ : ℂ) (z : Fin n → ℂ) (a b : Fin n) :
ℂ

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzForm {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (z : Fin n → ℂ) :
(Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] A

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.kzL_apply {n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) →* A) (c : ℂ) (a b : Fin n) (u : Fin n → ℂ) :
(kzL ρ c a b) u = (u a - u b) • resid ρ c a b

(Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] A

A

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.pairDiff_self {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n) :
pairDiff a a = 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.pairDiff_apply {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n) (u : Fin n → ℂ) :
(pairDiff a b) u = u a - u b

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.pairDiff {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n) :
(Fin n → ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ

theorem QOU.Mass.KZHolonomy.isOpen_confSet (n : ℕ) :
IsOpen (confSet n)

Set (Fin n → ℂ)
